# Categorize AI applications
ai_categories = {
    'narrow_ai': [],
    'general_ai': [],
    'generative_ai': []
}

# Add examples to each category
ai_categories['narrow_ai'].append('spam filter')
ai_categories['narrow_ai'].append('chess engine')
ai_categories['general_ai'].append('does not exist yet')
ai_categories['generative_ai'].extend(['ChatGPT', 'DALL-E'])

# Print each category
for category, examples in ai_categories.items():
    print(f'{category}: {examples}')
